verdict.rationale: Neon documents an official 'Neon serverless driver' page, plus related Connection pooling and Data API pages, so a first-party driver aimed at serverless use exists. However, the evidence pack contains only the page titles, with no content showing HTTP or WebSocket transport, edge-runtime compatibility, or handling of short-lived connections. Missing for 10: documented HTTP query mode, documented WebSocket support, edge/serverless runtime compatibility details, short-lived connection behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
